name: reproduce-issue
author: nrwl
description: The single skill for reproducing an nx issue. Given a GitHub issue number (human entry) OR explicit repro parameters (agent entry), it runs the reproduction ENTIRELY inside an isolated Docker sandbox — gVisor on Linux, the Docker VM on macOS — so the untrusted repro's install scripts and commands never execute on the host, then reports whether it reproduces. Called by humans via "/reproduce-issue
